description: Typeset text you wrote with the person into a printed document (for a letter in a handwriting-style font, use hip_set_letter; for a file the person already has, use hip_get_upload_target). Needs a job_handle from hip_create_job. Add a letter or document whose text you wrote with the person. Have It Printed typesets it on US Letter paper in a clean serif font, in black and white, and counts its pages. Plain text only: separate paragraphs with a blank line; no images, tables or formatting. Call once per document. Returns the added document and its page count; next choose how it is mailed (hip_update_job) or get the price (hip_quote).

job_handle.description: the job_handle that hip_create_job returned (job_ followed by 32 hex characters). Only the API key that created the job can use it.

text.description: the full text to print, exactly as it should read

title.description: a short name for the document; it names the file and is not printed

name: hip_add_text_document
title: Add a written document
